title: RankED: Addressing Imbalance and Uncertainty in Edge Detection Using Ranking-based Losses
mechanism: Ranking loss that ranks positive over negative pixels (AP-style, handles extreme imbalance) plus a second ranking term that orders positive pixels by label certainty.
adaptation: Crack is 0.19% of pixels: replace soft Dice on crack with the ranking term. Certainty from agreement between the 2021 and 2022 crack label versions, or from distance to the label skeleton.
min_experiment: Arm = PF with RankED crack loss in place of crack Dice; baseline = PF; 5 seeds + 5-fold CV; metrics crack AP, relP/relR@2, IoU. Kill if CV crack AP not up and IoU drops > 0.01.
evidence: R: new SOTA on NYUD-v2, BSDS500 and Multicue edge detection.
prior_overlap: None; ranking/AP losses never tried (BRIEF loss row lists Lovasz and others as open).

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack is 0.19% of pixels, so the ranking term fits. Build the certainty map from the two label versions we already have, the BenchmarkEL 2021 original and 2022 revised crack masks, with d = 2 px. Cells with only one version get c = 1. Add L_Rank + L_Sort on the crack logit alongside CE + Dice.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + RankED losses on crack, 5 seeds, with a sub-arm using UAED-style weighting. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metrics: crack AP, relF1@2, crack IoU. Kill if AP and relF1@2 are both n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Apply L_Rank + L_Sort on the crack logit next to CE + Dice. Certainty from the two label versions on the same cells (BenchmarkEL 2021 original vs 2022 revised) with 2 px tolerance; single-version cells get certainty 1. AP is threshold-free, replacing the val-tuned crack logit bias.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + L_Rank (+ L_Sort; UAED weighting as sub-arm), 5 seeds; baseline house 5 seeds. Metrics crack AP, relF1@2 at val-chosen threshold, strict IoU at argmax. Kill if crack AP and relF1@2 both n.d. About 15 GPU-h.
